name: tabby-asciinema-helper
description: Native Asciinema recorder for Tabby. Record Terminal, Headless Target Sessions (Herdr Multi-Agents, Docker logs, Tmux) in pure .cast format seamlessly.
author: Yang Hee Jong

scripts.deploy: npm run build && rm -rf "$HOME/Library/Application Support/tabby/plugins/node_modules/tabby-asciinema-helper" && mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/Application Support/tabby/plugins/node_modules/tabby-asciinema-helper" && cp -r dist package.json README.md "$HOME/Library/Application Support/tabby/plugins/node_modules/tabby-asciinema-helper/"
